acceptance_criteria.text: Audit the public product, contributor, architecture, privacy, roadmap, release, source, test, governance, and work-item records against origin/main; publish a feature-maturity matrix and documentation discrepancy report with source and work-item evidence.

Rewrite README.md as a concise course-first platform overview that accurately describes the legacy certification workspace, current package runtime, maturity limits, local data, installation, documentation, security, licensing, and release status without stale screenshots or unsupported claims.

Provide a discoverable docs index and authoritative contributor path; document verified setup commands, actual RepoPact work-item/evidence/PR/closeout practice, independent technical review versus GitHub approval, and public-safe integration/content boundaries.

Reconcile AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, contributor onboarding, course-package/architecture docs, and related public guidance with the canonical work/, decisions/, audits/, evidence/, and governance/ records and current source behavior.

Reconcile ROADMAP.md and CHANGELOG.md with source, completed and active work, public releases/tags, and version metadata; state clearly that 1.4.1-beta.1 is unpublished and v2.0.0-beta.1 is only a proposed target.

Add a repeatable no-dependency documentation validator for relative links, local developer paths, credential-shaped strings, and release metadata consistency; resolve findings within the scoped public docs.
Run the documentation, RepoPact, content, accessibility, test, frontend build, and Rust validation gates that are available; record exact command results and any unavailable release-only checks.
Submit the documentation milestone through the established implementation pull request and retain the audit/work item for separate governance closeout after independent review and merge.
